newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government is allocating 1,287.15 million Swiss francs in a new money market claim series 3.350 at a price of 99.512, to yield 1.94 percent per annum.
The allocation must be paid for by September 5.

The previous series 3.349 series of three-month claims, paid for on August 29, raised 1,079.25 million francs and was also priced at 99.512 percent to yield 1.94 percent. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
